lyrics:
[Intro: low synth pulse, finger snaps]

[Verse 1: female voice, low and muttered]
Five a.m., I'm good, I'm good
Coffee, keys, I'm out the door
Everybody says, "How do you do it?"
I say sleep is such a bore

[Pre-Chorus: drums building, voice tightening]
Text me, call me, pile it on
I can take it, bring it on

[Chorus: huge, voice leaps an octave and holds]
I'm running on fumes
Watch me fly on empty
Needle on the red, and I'm not slowing down
I'm running on fumes
Tell me that you need me
I don't touch the ground, I don't touch the ground

[Verse 2: muttered again, a little faster]
Lunch is something in the car
Dinner's standing at the sink
Somebody said, "You look so tired"
I laughed so hard I couldn't think

[Pre-Chorus: drums building, voice tightening]
Text me, call me, pile it on
I can take it, bring it on

[Chorus: huge, voice leaps an octave and holds]
I'm running on fumes
Watch me fly on empty
Needle on the red, and I'm not slowing down
I'm running on fumes
Tell me that you need me
I don't touch the ground, I don't touch the ground

[Bridge: everything drops out, piano, voice small]
There's a light on the dashboard
I put my thumb across it
There's a light on the dashboard
Help me. I can't stop it.

[Final Chorus: full, top note cracking]
I'm running on fumes
Watch me fly on empty
Needle on the red, somebody slow me down
I'm running on fumes
Tell me you don't need me
Let me touch the ground, let me touch the ground

[Outro: piano, an engine ticking as it cools]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 86 BPM, 4/4, B-flat minor. A slow, heavy pulse with an explosive chorus.

VOICE: Female, raspy and slurred in the verses, sung low and fast as if not wanting to be heard. The chorus jumps more than an octave to a belted, cracking top note that she holds. The bridge is small and childlike. No vibrato on the high notes.

INSTRUMENTS: A low synth pulse, finger snaps, a huge reverbed kick and snare, piano, a wall of synth strings in the chorus, a deep sub bass, marching toms in the pre-chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:34 Pre-chorus. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:12 Verse 2. 1:36 Pre-chorus. 1:46 Chorus 2. 2:14 Bridge, piano only. 2:38 Final chorus. 3:08 Outro, an engine cooling, ends 3:26.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2014 electro-pop ballad: sparse verses, enormous choruses, drums like cannon, vocal raw and up front.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The leap on 'I'm running on fumes' at 0:44.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original hides drinking behind a party. The socially approved version at forty-five is overwork, and the lyric changes one word in the last chorus to ask for the opposite of what she has been boasting about.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Bragging, soaring, frightened, asking for help.
